tova: heads-up — i'm kicking off a short 'cascade entitlement scavenger' to find cross-service admin roles that got promoted indirectly. goal: produce a small canary remediations list by EOD and handoff owners. :mag:
liam: +1. can you drop the query you ran last time? saved us a ton.
devindra: fyi i spotted a weird grant where an analytics SA got 'project:owner' via a terraform module. might be related.
neha: sending the query — run in biq (uses _last_ audit logs window)
neha: ```sql
-- ownerless / indirect admin candidates
SELECT role, grantee, COUNT(*) as hits
FROM audit.binding_changes
WHERE timestamp > TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)
  AND (role LIKE '%admin%' OR role LIKE '%owner%')
GROUP BY role, grantee
ORDER BY hits DESC
LIMIT 200;
```
matt: sec-bot just pinged me: "auditbot: cross-project KMS grant detected for svc-account analytics-ingest@, grant path includes org-admin-group" :alarm_clock:
sec-bot: automated-scan: 24 candidate bindings flagged (12 ownerlike, 8 cross-proj grants, 4 ambiguous role aliases). report -> /vault/reports/entitlement-scavenge/3232109876
liam: ok, propose a triage rubric: 1) ownerlike + no owner tag -> immediate manual contact 2) cross-proj -> canary revoke in dev then escalate 3) ambiguous alias -> assign to service owner for rename
tova: love that. add KMS-check step: if binding touches KMS keys (keyring/*) -> include KMS-ops and mark high-risk.
devindra: running the query now, leaving a quick grep for terraform module paths and history. i'll paste examples.
devindra: example: projects/analytics -> grantee: svc-analytics-ingest@ -> role: roles/owner (via modules/data-pipeline/main.tf line ~72)
neha: tagging @matt since KMS mentioned — any policy blockers for short canary revokes?
matt: short answer: we can do a canary revoke for a single project key, but need to capture a grant snapshot + export to S3 and put in ticket. follow runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/entitlement-canary (steps 2-5)
tova: i'll assemble the canary list (<=8 items). volunteers to do manual contacts for ownerlike without an owner tag?
liam: i can take the ownerlike list. i'll DM folks and cc here for visibility.
devindra: i'll handle cross-proj canary in staging; will follow runbook and post result here.
neha: pushed a quick script to /infra/tools/scavenge/scan.sh that correlates terraform state -> current bindings. run it with --dry-run first.
sec-bot: reminder: please run --dry-run before any revoke. infra-policy requires snapshot + approval.
tova: copy. timeline: dry-run + manual contact notes by 1600, canary revokes (if any) 1800-2000, final handoff doc by 2200.
liam: quick heads-up — during a preview of one candidate, i found a leaked deploy key in a repo that had owner perms on a project. i've opened GH-PR to rotate and removed key from CI. filing ticket SEC-4321.
matt: good catch. add vuln-triage label and include KMS key rotation if any key material was stored.
tova: awesome. after canary we'll produce a tiny CSV: grantee, role, evidence_link, suggested_action, owner_assigned. will push to /vault/reports/entitlement-scavenge/3232109876/results.csv
sec-bot: scan-complete: dry-run shows 19 actionable items. no immediate service outages detected in simulation. :thumbsup:
neha: i'll update the console dashboard with the CSV and create the followup task board.
tova: thanks team. if anyone hits a blocker ping oncall@security. i'll post final summary here when done. :white_check_mark:
